limitations: Two markets and 16 frozen cutoffs produce 80 overlapping descriptive windows, not 80 independent samples.
6480 retained market-update pair references use only 819 distinct condition-plus-index-pair keys; these are not necessarily independent source pairs across markets.
Both received-time endpoints inside the closed descriptive window differ from the production right-endpoint variance loop; no production estimator is copied or changed.
No best-window selection, initial_sigma, probability, Brier, parameters, risk or profit.
Timing/RSS/raw output size come from the first comparator-defect binary; corrected-tool performance and output size are unmeasured.
The original 8,491,168-byte committed input was read once; no prepare, public replay, Parquet or additional-date read.
